title: Appliance Rebates in Brampton 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Brampton appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient replacements, with Alectra Utilities as distributor.
lead: Brampton has 182,470 households, 78% of them owners. The six appliance rebates run from $25 to $200 and need an existing electric appliance to replace.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Brampton
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: 96,015 Brampton households live in detached houses. For an owner, the sensible places to start are the appliances already near the end of their life and the heat pump dryer, which pays $200 and is the largest of the six.
Alectra Utilities and the Ontario grid

The page asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. Alectra Utilities is Brampton's distributor, and Cornwall is the only area the page excludes. Brampton postal codes begin with L, which the Energy Affordability Program lists for the free fridge and freezer route.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Brampton households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.

About 23% of Brampton's 182,470 households live in homes built before 1981. Age of the house tells you little about the age of the fridge, and a working appliance rarely pays back a swap through a $25 to $200 rebate alone. The rebate suits a replacement you already need to make.
Buy new, then upload the receipt

Buy a new appliance from any retailer, then upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase. Used and refurbished units do not qualify. Keep the receipt, the model number and the delivery date together. Brampton households who buy during a sale should still confirm the model is on the list at the time they check out.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Brampton condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 22% of Brampton households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Can I replace a gas dryer with a heat pump dryer and claim?
The page asks for an existing electric appliance. Ask the program about gas.
Is there a Brampton city rebate?
The page does not require one.
Do I need the old appliance picked up?
The page does not address disposal.
